# scamp_vps (Resource)

Manages a Simple VPS: a server with a fixed plan, a public IPv4 address and an IPv6 prefix.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scamp_ssh_key" "laptop" {
  key_name   = "laptop"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}

resource "scamp_vps" "web" {
  name        = "web-1"
  plan        = "vps2-1"
  image       = "debian-13"
  ssh_key_ids = [scamp_ssh_key.laptop.id]
  backups     = true
}

output "web_ipv4" {
  value = scamp_vps.web.ipv4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Image id, e.g. debian-13 (see the scamp_vps_images data source). Changing it replaces the server.
- `name` (String) Name of the server: 3 to 24 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. Changing it replaces the server.
- `plan` (String) Plan id, e.g. vps2-1 (see the scamp_vps_plans data source). Changed in place to a bigger plan, the server restarts; a smaller plan is refused because the disk cannot shrink.

### Optional

- `backups` (Boolean) Daily backups; they add the plan's backup share to the price. Turning them off deletes every backup of the server.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Root password, 8 to 128 characters. Kept in the state like any sensitive value. Changing it replaces the server; the API does not return it, so after an import a value set in the config is only recorded.
- `reverse_dns` (String) Reverse DNS of the IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, e.g. mail.example.com. Without it the default name (hostname) is used.
- `ssh_key_ids` (List of Number) IDs of SSH keys saved in the account (scamp_ssh_key) to put on the server. Set this, password, or both. The keys go onto the server once, when it is made, so changing the list replaces the server; to keep the server, add lifecycle { ignore_changes = [ssh_key_ids] }. The API does not return it, so after an import a value set in the config is only recorded.

### Read-Only

- `cpu_model` (String) CPU model of the host.
- `created_at` (String) When the server was made.
- `hostname` (String) The default name of the server, NAME-xxxxxx.vm.scamp.pro.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the VPS.
- `ipv4` (String) Public IPv4 address.
- `ipv6_prefix` (String) The server's IPv6 prefix, e.g. 2a01:ea05:0:2400::/56.
- `status` (String) running, stopped, paused, unpaid or error.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The id is the VPS UUID, from the panel, scli vps ls or the API.
# Write the config as the server is before the first apply: a server with backups needs backups = true,
# otherwise the apply turns them off and deletes every backup.
# password and ssh_key_ids cannot be read back; set them in the config and they are only recorded.
terraform import scamp_vps.web 12d46f8c-d66e-4163-99aa-1245d5b06e5b
```
